_provenance.window: measured — Claude Code hands it over in the statusline payload (context_window.context_window_size). This is the EFFECTIVE window CC applies: it honors the [1m] suffix, the CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS override and the 200k clamp. null = take it from the payload; set an integer only to force a value.
_provenance.hifi: measured but NOT specific to Claude 5 — NoLiMa (arXiv:2502.05167) measured 12 models and 11 of them lost more than 50% of their baseline at 32k on associative reasoning. The only Claude in that set is 3.5 Sonnet. For Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Fable 5 this is extrapolation, not measurement.
_provenance.compact: published — the default trigger for Anthropic's server-side compaction. It is the only published mark still current for the 5 family.
_provenance.dump: derived — a heuristic at 40% of the window. No measurement behind it.
_provenance.haiku: Haiku 4.5 carries its own marks because its window is 200k: the global 150k would land at 75% and leave no useful orange band.

_note: The marks are clipped to the effective window at render time, so a 400k dump over a 200k window does not break the bar.
